description: Update department of an organization. Changed permissions are applied to the members of the department, except for the ones with custom permission levels.

department.description: name of the department (or its external identifier if no department has this name)

id.description: external unique department identifier, empty string removes it

leaders.description: comma-separated list of user identification strings of the leaders (must be members of the organization, maximum 5), replaces the current leaders, empty string removes every leader

parent.description: name (or external identifier) of the parent department, empty string moves the department to the root level, the department itself or a department below it cannot be the parent

permission_content.description: permission level to contents in organization given to the members (none / view / report / control / modify / grant / admin)

permission_members.description: permission level to members in organization given to the members (none / department / organization)

permission_organization.description: permission level to organization given to the members (member / teacher / reporter / supervisor / admin)

permission_reset.description: reset the custom permission levels of the members, so every member follows the permission levels of the department (default: false)

title.description: new name of the department, must be unique within the organization

name: edubase_patch_organization_department
